notes: v-data independent verification. Series built from data/lcl2013_kwh_filled.npy (validated vs raw CSVs) and data/selection.parquet / authors_clusters_recovered.parquet; no import from REPRO/lib. DiD: cluster mean minus Std mean (1,032 Std) on event days vs K nearest clean days (Normal in authors' and all xlsx candidate schedules +-8 slots) of the same daytype (workday vs weekend/holiday) and DST regime; % = sum(effect)/sum(counterfactual); 95% CI = percentile bootstrap over event days (B=2000).
